properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued July 27 at 9:20PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 920 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 15
miles south of Pueblo Reservoir, or 17 miles southwest of Pueblo,
moving northeast at 10 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

This storm will remain over mainly rural areas of central Pueblo
County.
